notes.title: Master Lemon: The Quest for Iceland is now in Closed Beta!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097867/95de434ba268c525e0ee4710f61b2486c50d420d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097867/95de434ba268c525e0ee4710f61b2486c50d420d.gif[/img][/url]

After three years of development, [b]Master Lemon: The Quest for Iceland[/b] is now in Closed Beta. We are incredibly grateful for all the support and love we've received so far! Our entire team is working hard to ensure the game is released with the highest quality, and we will continue to count on you throughout our journey. We’re thrilled about this new milestone.🍋

As we progress, we’ll keep you updated both here and on our social media!

Big hugs!❤️
